resources.string: CarPlay: diagnostics and Ultra
Connection stages, report and experimental mode
CarPlay Ultra — experimental

Applies on the next connection. Adds the Ultra protocol and app information. Zeekr climate, radio and vehicle readings are not integrated. No commands are sent to the car. Not yet verified with an iPhone.
Detailed protocol diagnostics
For troubleshooting. Applies on the next connection and increases technical logging. Disable after testing. The exported report contains only stages and error categories.
